subject.title: [Feature]: Support sessionKey-based concurrency guard for webhook       deliveries

question: Should same-session webhook deliveries be rejected with 409, queued, serialized, or left parallel by default, and should that policy be opt-in per hook or mapping?
rationale: This changes an external HTTP webhook contract and retry semantics for existing integrations, so automation should not choose the permanent overlap/default policy.

options.title: Add opt-in overlap policy
options.body: Introduce an explicit hook or mapping policy such as skip, queue, or parallel while preserving today's default behavior for existing callers.

options.title: Adopt unconditional 409
options.body: Implement the reporter's exact behavior for every same-session active hook delivery and accept the compatibility break for callers that currently expect 200/runId.

options.title: Fold into queued webhooks
options.body: Defer this issue until queued-webhook ingestion chooses durable backlog, parallelism, and caller response semantics together.

recommendation.title: Add opt-in overlap policy
recommendation.body: Introduce an explicit hook or mapping policy such as skip, queue, or parallel while preserving today's default behavior for existing callers.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent owns the current main hook request/dispatch code by blame, so he is the best available routing owner for the immediate contract decision.
